|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[The Camp (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p4-76-The_Camp.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-thecamp-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[The Camp (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-p4-76-The_Camp-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Unless your [Reflections 2] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permanent Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique (•) character of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be ‘swung’ twice. Once per game, may ▲ one K’lor’slug or a [Setup] card. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 15, 2010"; PDF made 23 December 2010), Light Side p. 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 30). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[The Camp (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Camp (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “characters” for “character” (it writes the icons as “[Reflections II]” and “[Permenant Weapon]”, drops the uniqueness dot and writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permenant Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique () characters of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be 'swung' twice. Once per game, may take one K'lor'slug or a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1272_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
